authorship: Original short examples, prose, quizzes and applications constructed for this partition; standard language syntax is not claimed novel. Official documentation used for topic/fact validation, not copied exercises.
runtimeBoundary: These examples use ordinary Swift language/library features intended to be compatible with Swift 6.0. Actual native validation uses Swift 6.4.1 on Linux with explicit language mode 6; it does not verify compiler 6.0, Apple SDKs or the app’s connected Mac environment.
